name: Cosplay☆Tea Party
original_name: こすぷれ☆ティーパーティー
source:
Main character gets dragged to an alumni association meeting by his two friends who wish to temporarily revive high school cosplay club consisting of six pretty girls. Protagonist gets attracted by their charm, especially by "rabbit" girl Yuka.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-june-2004-3days-michiteyuku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角被两名朋友拖去参加校友会聚会。朋友希望暂时复活由六名漂亮女孩组成的高中角色扮演社。主角被她们的魅力吸引，尤其是“兔子”女孩由香。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-june-2004-3days-michiteyuku.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
